How can a thin stick pass through a stone face that looks completely solid? 👀🪨

Look closely at this intricate ancient sculpture—the tiny passage carved through the face showcases an extraordinary level of precision and attention to detail. What appears simple from a distance becomes fascinating when viewed up close.

The craftsmanship reflects the patience, skill, and artistic vision of ancient Indian sculptors, who transformed solid stone into remarkably detailed works of art. 🛕✨🙏
